changed.title: Minimum numbers of raw sites and read wires for uniformly distributed binary reports
changed.statement:
let Word := fun k : Nat => Fin k → ZMod 2
let localRule := fun (n : Nat) (D : Fin n → Finset (Fin n)) (T : Fin n → Word n → ZMod 2) =>
  ∀ i x y, (∀ j ∈ D i, x j = y j) → T i x = T i y
let observed := fun (n m : Nat) (Q : Fin n → Word m) (U : Finset (Fin n))
    (T : Fin n → Word n → ZMod 2) (b : Word n) (z : U → ZMod 2) (r : Fin m) =>
  let x := fun i : Fin n => if h : i ∈ U then z ⟨i,h⟩ else b i
  ∑ i, (x i + T i x) * Q i r
let uniform := fun (n m : Nat) (D : Fin n → Finset (Fin n)) (Q : Fin n → Word m)
    (U : Finset (Fin n)) =>
  ∀ T, localRule n D T → ∀ b v,
    2^m * Nat.card {z : U → ZMod 2 // observed n m Q U T b z = v} = 2^U.card
let readers := fun (n : Nat) (D : Fin n → Finset (Fin n)) (j : Fin n) =>
  (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => j ∈ D i)).card
let wires := fun (n : Nat) (D : Fin n → Finset (Fin n)) => ∑ i, (D i).card
∀ m : Nat, 1 ≤ m →
  let N := 2^m - 1
  (∃ (D : Fin N → Finset (Fin N)) (Q : Fin N → Word m),
    (∀ i, i ∉ D i) ∧
    (∀ i, (Finset.univ.filter (fun r => Q i r ≠ 0)).card ≤ 2) ∧
    (∀ j, readers N D j = m-1) ∧ wires N D = N*(m-1) ∧
    (∀ U, uniform N m D Q U ↔ U = Finset.univ)) ∧
  (∀ (n : Nat) (D : Fin n → Finset (Fin n)) (Q : Fin n → Word m) (W : Finset (Fin n)),
    W.card = N → uniform n m D Q Finset.univ →
    (∀ j ∈ W, ¬ uniform n m D Q (Finset.univ.erase j)) →
    N ≤ n ∧ (∀ j ∈ W, m-1 ≤ readers n D j) ∧ N*(m-1) ≤ wires n D)
changed.unlocks: This would give the exact number of sensor read wires needed to make all possible nonzero report parities require different raw sites.

changed.title: Three unit-cost matchings encode NAND failures and count satisfying extensions under zero pins
changed.statement:
∃ C : ℕ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (v g : ℕ) (a b z : Fin g → Fin v),
  let X := Fin v → Bool
  let add := fun (s t : Bool) => decide (s ≠ t)
  let bad := fun (x : X) => (Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin g =>
    x (z j) ≠ !(x (a j) && x (b j)))).card
  ∃ n : ℕ, n ≤ C*(v+g+1) ∧
    let V := Bool × Fin n
    let Y := V → Bool
    ∃ (σ τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (mark : (Fin (v+1) × Bool) ↪ V)
        (enc : X → Bool → Y) (dec : Y → X × Bool),
      let cost := fun (y : Y) =>
        (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => y (false,i) ≠ y (true,i))).card +
        (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => y (false,i) ≠ y (true,σ i))).card +
        (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => y (false,i) = y (true,τ i))).card
      (∀ q, (mark q).1 = false) ∧
      (∀ (x : X) (r : Bool), dec (enc x r) = (x,r) ∧
        (∀ s : Bool, enc x r (mark (0,s)) = add r s) ∧
        (∀ (i : Fin v) (s : Bool), enc x r (mark (i.succ,s)) = add (add (x i) r) s) ∧
        (Finset.univ.filter (fun p : V => enc x r p = true)).card = n ∧
        cost (enc x r) = 6*g + 2*bad x) ∧
      (∀ y : Y, (Finset.univ.filter (fun p : V =>
        y p ≠ enc (dec y).1 (dec y).2 p)).card + C*(6*g + 2*bad (dec y).1) ≤ C*cost y) ∧
      ∀ pins : Fin v → Option Bool,
        (Finset.univ.filter (fun y : Y => cost y = 6*g ∧ y (mark (0,false)) = false ∧
          ∀ (i : Fin v) (s : Bool), pins i = some s → y (mark (i.succ,s)) = false)).card =
        (Finset.univ.filter (fun x : X => bad x = 0 ∧
          ∀ (i : Fin v) (s : Bool), pins i = some s → x i = s)).card
